t: The limit on not speaking to someone
a: لاَ يَكُونُ لِمُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَهْجُرَ مُسْلِمًا فَوْقَ ثَلاَثَةٍ فَإِذَا لَقِيَهُ سَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ كُلُّ ذَلِكَ لاَ يَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ فَقَدْ بَاءَ بِإِثْمِهِ
p: Lā yakūnu li-muslimin an yahjura musliman fawqa thalāthah. Fa-idhā laqiyahu sallama ʿalayhi thalātha mirārin kullu dhālika lā yaruddu ʿalayhi faqad bāʾa bi-ithmih
m: It is not for a Muslim to cut off another Muslim beyond three days. If he meets him and greets him three times and gets no reply each time, the other has taken the sin on himself.
